en.hook: Warehouse bills keep climbing while “incremental” models rebuild work that already existed.
en.body:
dbt Fusion vs SQLMesh is less about brand preference and more about how rebuilds, planning, and incremental contracts burn compute.

If your modern data stack on GCP still pays for avoidable reprocessing, the engine choice is a cost control decision — not a fashion cycle.
en.cta: Curious which pattern fits your warehouse? Breakdown on the site + stack proof in the repo.
